description: Search ~1,900 GTA VI locations matched to the real Miami/Florida places they're based on (community data from map.gtadb.org, CC BY 4.0). Search by in-game area or by real place, e.g. 'Ocean Drive', 'Bal Harbour', 'Vice Beach', 'airport'. Optionally limit to a radius around an in-game position (meters).

confirmed_only.description: Only return landmarks the gtadb.org community has confirmed against a real address.

limit.description: Maximum number of landmarks to return.

near_x.description: East-west map position in in-game meters (x grows east). Use with near_y to search around a point.

near_y.description: North-south map position in in-game meters (y grows north). Use with near_x.

query.description: Words to match in the in-game location or the real-world place.

name: search_landmarks
title: Real-world landmarks in GTA VI
